It also fires weakly on scattered mid-phrase words in web text, such as "Environmental" in Environmental Protection and "for" in National Center for. Pushes the model toward counting digits 0-9.

L27n2379.name: Letter after Washington, D.C.
L27n2379.description: Fires negative on the single capital letter after a place name, above all "D" in "Washington, D.C.". It also fires on one-letter word-start pieces such as "M" in MMS and "-m" in moon. Pushes the model toward "line" and "lines".

L27n969.name: Quantifier before a set
L27n969.description: Fires on 'various', 'different', 'few', 'certain', 'several', 'some' or 'key' right before a plural noun for a range of things, e.g. 'various types', 'many different crops', 'one of the few options'. Pushes toward plural group nouns: blocks, sets, slices, strips.

L27n1711.name: Noun-start fragment, writes 'down'
L27n1711.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalised noun or food word split into pieces, mostly P-initial: 'Pell' in pellagra, 'Par' in parmesan, 'Pi' in Pietermaritzburg, 'P' in Pisa. Pushes toward 'down' and 'below'; steered, it spams them.

L27n1272.name: 'w' word-start, writes 'write'
L27n1272.description: Fires on a word-initial 'w' or 'W' fragment, e.g. 'w' in 'wiser', '-W' in 'Writes', 'unw' in 'unworthy', plus a few other short word-start pieces. Pushes toward 'write', 'writing' and 'written'; steered, it spams 'write'.

L27n1949.name: Place-name fragment, writes 'half'
L27n1949.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, e.g. 'Tr' in Trang, 'Sw' in Swindon, 'Ch' in Chaco, 'Bo' or 'ant' in Bantus. Pushes toward 'half' and 'halves'; steered, it spams 'half'.

L27n966.name: Quantifier before category noun
L27n966.description: Fires on 'other', 'another', 'various', 'common' or 'a' right before a category noun phrase, e.g. 'other space weather events', 'a common and painful condition', 'various mental illnesses'. Pushes toward 'forms' and 'form'; steered, it spams them.

L27n179.name: Heading label's last word
L27n179.description: Fires on the last word of a short title or list label, e.g. 'Vitamin E' in a vitamin list, 'Africa' in 'What Animals Live in Africa?', 'Options Available'. Pushes toward commas and opening brackets; steered, it spams commas and newlines.

L27n864.name: Verb after auxiliary
L27n864.description: Fires on the main verb or participle right after an auxiliary or 'is/be/had' (is used, is injected, have not exercised, then works, starts acting), plus some word-piece tails like 'ole' and 'ested'; pushes toward 'system' tokens.

L27n2139.name: Names and place fragments
L27n2139.description: Negative on split word-starts in names and terms: 'P' in Palla, 'T' in Tigris, 'Z' in Zeldovich, 'A' in Agra, 't' in turret, 'sea' in sea floor; pushes toward 'grade' tokens.

L27n1954.name: Rare split word starts
L27n1954.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'uns' in unsupervised, 'Por' in Porifera, '-s' in self-sufficiency; pushes toward 'touch' tokens.

L27n240.name: Names and foreign scripts
L27n240.description: Negative on the first piece of a proper name or non-Latin word (Fr in Franks, Schro in Schroers, Thai พระ, Arabic ابن); pushes toward '(' and '())' bracket tokens.

L27n1128.name: Modifiers of technical compounds
L27n1128.description: Fires on the word or piece right before a technical noun in a compound ('soft' in soft tissue, 'verte' in vertebral, 'computed' in computed tomography, 'Prot' in Protolaurasia); pushes toward the letter 'X'.

L27n2739.name: Split word-start pieces
L27n2739.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'sw' in swimmers and swamps, 'Bal' in Balochistan, 'Bel' in Belo Horizonte, 'Ble' in bleach; pushes toward 'treatment' tokens.

L27n1014.name: Rare-word mid pieces
L27n1014.description: Fires on a middle or first piece of a rare split word, e.g. 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'esp' in Vespasianus, 'cl' in clots, 'pl' in germplasm; pushes toward 'user' tokens.

L27n1327.name: Newline before assistant turn
L27n1327.description: Negative on the newline right after '<|im_end|>' that opens the assistant turn in chat text, and weaker on hyphen-split pieces like '-S' in Fat-Soluble or '-h' in rainwater; pushes toward 'source' tokens.

L27n1405.name: Long-word start fragments
L27n1405.description: Negative on the first piece of a longer split word, e.g. 'agr' in agritech and agrarian, 'Com' in compost, 'Aud' in auditory, 'Fr' in Franks; pushes toward 'material', 'service' and 'resource'.

L27n1139.name: Proper-name start fragments
L27n1139.description: Negative on the first pieces of capitalised names split into tokens (Lo in DeLores, Pot in Potomac, Hos in Hosack, Pur in Puritan, Las in Las Vegas, tur in turkeys); pushes toward 'key' tokens.

L27n137.name: Auxiliary before predicate
L27n137.description: Fires on the auxiliary or adverb just before the main verb or adjective ('has' in it has been, 'also' in have also been, 'most' in most common, 'be' in can be tamed); pushes toward sentence openers 'Also', 'Now', 'Is'.

L27n229.name: Surname pieces in names
L27n229.description: Fires on a surname or its first piece, mostly in citations, bylines and quotes ('Lans' in Lansdell, 'Arn' in Arnott, 'Fish' after Nick, 'News' in Newsom); pushes toward all-caps tokens like 'AS', 'IS', 'AB'.

L27n227.name: Options and alternatives
L27n227.description: Fires on the word opening a list of alternatives or categories ('or' in desktop or laptop, 'study' in study tools, 'Commod' in Commodities) and on split-word starts like 'paraph' and 'Typ'; pushes toward 'options', 'settings', 'terms'.

L27n2835.name: Am/Imm word starts
L27n2835.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting 'Am' or 'Imm' (Amoretti, immune, immunodeficiency, amoeba), and similar 'Hor' and 'Or' starts; pushes toward 'mine' tokens.

L27n235.name: Rare foreign name pieces
L27n235.description: Negative on a middle or first piece of a rare name or foreign word (Ikht-iy-ar, Arabic ابن in Ibn Rushd, Abdu'l-B-ah-á, Po-iret, self-h-arm); pushes toward word-end pieces like 'urer' and 'arter'.

L27n620.name: Article before noun phrase
L27n620.description: Fires on the article or determiner right before a noun phrase, strongest on 'a' before a quantity ('a total of', 'a spot', 'a CAGR of') and on 'the', 'this' and 'its'; pushes toward intensity adjectives like robust, dense, intense and lush.

L27n1877.name: Prefix-like word starts
L27n1877.description: Negative on the first piece of a split word that starts with a common prefix, e.g. 'Comp' in Organic Compounds, 'con' in concentric, 'dis' in superoxide dismutase, 'Dis' in Discovered; pushes toward 'complex' tokens.

L27n965.name: Name-like split pieces
L27n965.description: Fires on a piece of a split word, often the start of a place or person name ('Her' in Herat, 'Mand' in Mandeb, 'Wak' in Wakayama, 'Rep' in Repat, 'ent' in entitles); pushes toward 'points' tokens.

L27n1597.name: Split word pieces
L27n1597.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or compound, e.g. 'dise' in diseased, 'inf' in infantry, 'ar' in Caernarvon, 'eye' in eye-catching, 'iest' in bloodiest; pushes toward 'action' tokens.

L27n1969.name: Event name inner words
L27n1969.description: Negative on a key word inside an event or campaign name, e.g. 'Awareness' in Motorcycle Safety Awareness, 'science' in science fair, 'field' in school field trip, 'Fun' in Family Fun Day; pushes toward 'day' tokens.

L27n175.name: Name fragments → ordinals
L27n175.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or title split into tokens (La|Hood, La Coupole, Ste|jskal, T|igris), before the rest of the name. Pushes toward ordinal numbers ('third', 'fifth', 'seventh').

L27n1316.name: Mid-word fragments → 'image'
L27n1316.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a long word split into tokens (telesc|ope, Yog|i, ins|cribed, v|ibrate, pilgr|im), just before the word finishes. Pushes toward 'image' (steered output becomes 'Image image image').

L27n1993.name: Uppercase fragments → AS/IS
L27n1993.description: Fires on uppercase pieces of all-caps or split capitalized words (NO|PASSWD, LE|As, MEN|A, I|GF-1, BT|W), mostly the capital letters right after a split. Pushes toward uppercase 'AS' and 'IS' tokens.

L27n2128.name: Split-word starts → 'period'
L27n2128.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or name split into tokens, mid-sentence (G|rotius, mer|cury, Tim|ely, Hos|feld, Ha|irstyles, enc|losures). Goes negative toward 'period'/'Period', giving period spam.

L27n446.name: Split-word openers → pronouns
L27n446.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word split into tokens (kne|els, fo|als, And|alusia, self-h|arm, Ze|alots), before the word ends. Goes negative toward sentence-opening subject pronouns ('You', 'We', 'This', 'It').

L27n1760.name: Split-name pieces → 'left'
L27n1760.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a multi-token name or word (Cour|tyard, Dorm|agen, Ton|awanda, Ber|zelius, cl|enching), just before its last piece. Goes negative toward 'left'/'Left', giving left spam.

L27n2304.name: Split-word pieces → 'round'
L27n2304.description: Fires on a first or middle piece of a word split into tokens (amin|og|lycoside, gl|ottal, imp|oundment, mor|ose, bra|ai, terr|acing), before the word completes. Pushes toward 'round'/'Round' (steered output: 'Round round round').

L27n3014.name: Consonant-cluster onsets → 'amount'
L27n3014.description: Fires on a word-initial consonant-cluster piece of a split word, mostly cl, cr, sn, sp, fl (cl|umping, cr|umble, cl|apping, sn|ail, Clo|jure), plus a few -ch and -sc pieces. Pushes toward 'amount'/'Amount'.

L27n1966.name: Life fragments → 'support'
L27n1966.description: Fires on 'life' and other split-word pieces that begin a continuation (life|less, life|boat, odef|iciency, os|arcoma, cre|vice). Goes negative toward 'support'/'Support' (steered output: 'Support support support').

L27n2264.name: Split-term tails → 'cost'
L27n2264.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a split name or term (Or|isk|any, Per|itone|al, poly|cy|stic, unw|arranted, inter|ventional), rarely the first piece. Pushes toward 'cost'/'Cost' (steered output: 'Cost cost cost').

L27n2067.name: Noun-start fragments → 'role'
L27n2067.description: Fires on the first piece of a common noun or name split into tokens, strongest on 'bl' in blower(s), also 'shr' (shrub), 'sk' (skit), 'Rh' (rhinoceros), 'Clem' (Clemenceau). Goes negative toward 'role'/'Role' (steered output: 'Role role role').

L27n31.name: Clause-end punctuation → commas
L27n31.description: Fires on the comma or period that closes an introductory phrase or clause before a new clause ('In other words,' 'In fact,' 'But', 'So') in English prose. Goes negative toward comma-like punctuation '，' and '。', so steered output becomes a run of commas.

L27n1193.name: Split-word piece → 'starting'
L27n1193.description: Fires on an early piece of a split word or place name, e.g. 'og' in aminoglycoside, 'by' in Abyei, 'Fr' in Franks, 'g' in gauze or gingersnap. Pushes toward 'starting'/'opening'/'ending' (steered output: 'Starting starting').

L27n2915.name: Name-start fragments → '####'
L27n2915.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or noun split into tokens (Luk|in, Z|ulu, Hor|owitz, mon|asteries, mar|igold, sal|inity, trib|als). Goes negative toward '####' markdown headers and quote-comma tokens, giving '####' spam.

L27n2614.name: 'fl' onsets → 'flow'
L27n2614.description: Fires on 'fl' or 'infl' opening a split word (fl|ammable, infl|amed, fl|uvial, fl|ares, fl|ora), plus some 'inf' and 'ret' pieces. Pushes toward 'flow'/'Flow' (steered output: 'Flow flow flow').

L27n1281.name: 'has'/'’ve' before participle
L27n1281.description: Fires on an auxiliary like 'has' or '’ve', or 'which'/'was' after a subject, right before a past participle (Radiology has, we’ve done, it has standards), and on some split-word pieces (-f|ledged, str|addles). Pushes toward 'sorted'/'sort' (steered output: 'sorted sorted').

L27n972.name: Split-name pieces → 'end'
L27n972.description: Fires on word-start or mid-word pieces of split names and terms (Rever|comb, Te|ess|ide, Rhod|od|endron, O|phiostoma, BUY|ER), and on directional words 'east', 'west', 'hind'. Pushes toward 'end'/'End' (steered output: 'End end end').

L27n681.name: Pre-noun modifier → 'case'
L27n681.description: Fires on a modifier before a noun in formal or educational prose ('two years', 'four different concentrations', 'national programs', 'state standards', 'ecological zones'). Goes negative toward head nouns 'case', 'example', 'instance' (steered output: 'case case case').

L27n2811.name: Symptom-pair 'or' → enjoy
L27n2811.description: Fires on 'or' linking two near-synonyms in a symptom or description (chest pain or discomfort, pressure or a squeezing pain), plus some split-word pieces. Pushes toward 'enjoying'/'enjoy'/'leisure' (steered output: 'enjoying enjoying').

L27n491.name: Split-word starts → caps
L27n491.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word (appet|izing, gr|illing, gen|otyped, sc|arring, mic|rometre), mostly lowercase stems. Pushes toward uppercase fragments 'OS', 'AL', 'SC', 'AC' and garbled text, though steering sometimes still gives coherent output.

L27n2157.name: Omniscient and tense terms
L27n2157.description: The 'isc' piece of 'omniscient' after 'omn' in third-person POV prompts, and 'Present' in tense-label lists; pushes toward 'active' and 'Active'.

L27n3018.name: Rare-word first pieces
L27n3018.description: Fires on the first or early piece of a rare or proper-noun word split into tokens, such as 'Ant|ial', 'neo|classical', 'ench|il|ada', 'Rab|as', 'Coll|atine' and 'flash|cards'; pushes 'class/classical'.

L27n410.name: Verb stem before -ing
L27n410.description: Mostly the stem piece of a verb split before its '-ing' ending (f|lossing, sne|ezing, fl|aring, rem|aking, St|aying); pushes toward gerund verbs like creating, making and taking.

L27n1172.name: Place-name fragments
L27n1172.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized place or thing name split into tokens, such as 'T|oulouse', 'Or|iskany', 'cre|vasse', 'lo|cket' and 'cr|annog'; pushes 'station/facilities'.

L27n346.name: Inner word fragment (negative)
L27n346.description: Negative on a middle or final piece of a word split into several tokens (cantal|ou|pe, mar|ipa, philadel|phus, Gar|trap); when pushed negative it writes p-initial pieces like pr, pi, py and pl.

L27n512.name: Paren before acronym
L27n512.description: Negative on an opening '(' right after a spelled-out name and just before an acronym (Commission (CISA), Dry Eye Syndrome (DES)); when pushed negative it writes syllable starts like se, que and co.

L27n1315.name: Inner pieces of names
L27n1315.description: Goes negative on a middle sub-token of a split surname or foreign proper name, such as 'Kh|ulaifi', 'Ef|remov', 'Radc|huk' and 'Sp|ang', where the name is still continuing; pushes '@' tokens.

L27n1908.name: Lone 'd' word-start
L27n1908.description: Fires on a lone 'd' or 'D' that begins a word piece, often after a hyphen or at a split word start, such as 'Und|eclared', 'd|umb', 'D|ialysis', 'flower-d|otted' and 'anti-d|rying'; pushes 'die/death'.

L27n2396.name: Intr/ultr/aqu word start
L27n2396.description: Negative on the first piece of words beginning intr-, ultr- or aqu- that are split into tokens (intr|avenous, ultr|aviolet, aqu|aculture); pushes toward capital 'A' tokens like AD, AP and AC.

L27n2057.name: Predicate-opening verb or modal
L27n2057.description: Goes negative on the first word of a predicate right after its subject, such as 'we <<can>> talk', 'people <<took>> place', 'it is <<our>> job' and 'to <<take>> steps', mostly modals and 'take/took'; pushes 'turn/turns'.

L27n1571.name: Lone 'D' word-start
L27n1571.description: Goes negative on a lone 'D' or 'd', or an 'St' start, that begins a word piece, such as 'Semi-d|warf', 'd|ocking', 'D|harma', 'nond|iscriminatory' and 'St|ewardship'; pushes 'double/dual'.

L27n115.name: Determiner before problem nouns
L27n115.description: Goes negative on the word that introduces a problem noun phrase, mainly 'these' after address/combat/identify ('address these issues'), 'of' after 'importance', and 'take' in 'take steps'; pushes code identifiers like 'ParameterValue'.

L27n2761.name: Hyphen 'st' fragment
L27n2761.description: The 'st' or '-st' piece opening a split or hyphenated word (pre-st|ressed, non-st|ick, St|abilizes, Est|epa); pushes toward 'birth', 'born' and 'baby'.

L27n947.name: Capitalized name fragments
L27n947.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, such as 'Fr|anks', 'Fr|isia', 'McM|urray', 'Hojib|lanca' and 'Pr|iscus'; pushes commas.

L27n1201.name: Modifier opening noun phrase
L27n1201.description: Fires on the article or first modifier that opens a noun phrase in an instruction or prepositional phrase, such as 'to <<a>> saucepan', 'with <<a>> bronze', 'electric griddle', 'plain hair clip' and 'accom|panied'; pushes nationality and style adjectives like 'Chinese/Japanese'.

L27n1999.name: Split word first piece
L27n1999.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into two tokens, such as 'my|corrhizae', 'Ath|lete', 'out|grow', 'mis|fits' and 'Mal|agasy'; pushes 'think/idea/thought'.

L27n1585.name: All-caps word fragments
L27n1585.description: Fires on an uppercase piece in the middle of an all-caps word or acronym, from the second piece on, such as 'SO' in 'SOA', 'NO' in 'CARTE|NOIRE', 'DO' in 'DOI', 'MO' in 'MOBI' and 'APPRO|ACH'; pushes 'pen/pers/plen' fragments.

L27n2444.name: Past-tense verb stems
L27n2444.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a past-tense or participle verb split into tokens, such as 'enc|roached', 'c|eded', 'reb|uked', 'spr|outed', 'w|aned' and 'anch|ised', with some name pieces mixed in; pushes 'found/Found'.

L27n1263.name: Medical-term word pieces
L27n1263.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a rare medical or technical word split into tokens, such as 'br|uxism', 'append|icit|is', 'cen|tigr|ade' and 'qu|asar'; pushes 'process/processes'.

L27n853.name: Acronym first letters
L27n853.description: Goes negative on the first letter of an acronym or institution name in a proper-noun slot, such as 'A' in 'Texas A&M', 'E' in 'EPA', 'C' in 'CBO', 'H' in 'HIT' and 'A' in 'AWWA'; pushes 'team/teams'.

L27n680.name: List-joining 'and' and commas
L27n680.description: Fires on the connector between items in a noun list: 'and' or a comma in 'Food and Drug', 'sardines, and albacore', 'Arithmetic, Algebra 1', and the 'a' in 'highlight a word'. Pushes toward 'min', 'max', 'tech', 'math', and its steered output only repeats 'min'.

L27n2185.name: Word-start fragments; forbidden
L27n2185.description: The first piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly capitalised or consonant-cluster starts such as 'St' in 'Stuffed', 'Pl' in 'Plague', 'Cr' in 'crater', 'car' in 'carob'. Pushes toward 'forbidden', 'excluded', 'banned', 'prohibited'.

L27n644.name: Title and proper-noun openers
L27n644.description: The first token of a title or proper name, such as 'Chief', 'Prince', 'Supreme', 'Electric', 'Linda', 'Yog', or the 'and' in 'Food and Drug'. Pushes toward frequency adverbs 'usually', 'typically', 'often', 'indeed'.

L27n2953.name: Tell/tale word fragments
L27n2953.description: The 't' or 'ret' piece that opens 'tell', 'tale', 'telling', 'tossed', and the '-t' in hyphenated 'tail' or 'tenths'. Pushes toward 'story', 'stories', 'tell', 'told'.

L27n2336.name: Word-start 'n'/'N' pieces
L27n2336.description: The first piece of a word beginning with n or N, such as 'n' in 'nose' and 'narrowing', 'N' in 'Native' and 'Nomenclature', and 'sn' in 'snags'. Pushes toward 'unique' and 'uniqueness'.

L27n1431.name: Split-word middle pieces
L27n1431.description: A middle piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'ely' in 'Thelypteridaceae', 'ch' in 'chelator' and 'choline', 'ry' in 'Phrynosoma', 'vas' in 'crevasse'. Pushes toward 'see', 'saw', 'seen'.

L27n602.name: Latin-name and compound fragments
L27n602.description: A piece of a multi-token name or compound, such as 'Card' in 'Cardiospermum', 'amb' in 'rambutan', 'db' in 'redbay', 'Ps' in 'Psittacula', and '-b' in '-borne'. Pushes toward the code suffix 'type'.

L27n288.name: Start of proper names
L27n288.description: The first piece of a capitalised name or acronym split across tokens, such as 'Sal' in 'Salazar', 'V' in 'Vespasian', 'H' in 'HIV', 'Vul' in 'Vulframni'. Pushes toward a bare capital 'S' token.

L27n3003.name: Word-start 'cre', 'che', 'Ne'
L27n3003.description: The first piece of a longer word or name, mostly 'cre' in 'creational' and 'crevasse', 'che' in 'Cheyenne' and 'Chester', 'Ne' in 'Neutrophils' and 'Neuchâtel'. Pushes toward 'ever' and 'never'.

L27n802.name: Turn-end newline; name starts
L27n802.description: Strongest on the newline that closes a user message just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat prompts. Also fires on capitalised name starts such as 'Pr', 'P', 'Pacific', 'Share'. Pushes toward the em dash '—'.

L27n786.name: Pest-list separators
L27n786.description: The comma, 'and' or 'of' linking items in lists of insects, pests or animals, such as 'lacewings, ladybugs' and 'fleas, mites and ticks'. Pushes toward 'was' and 'were'.

L27n1148.name: Word before -ing head
L27n1148.description: A word just before a hyphenated or compound -ing head, such as 'boat' in 'boat-building', 'decision' in 'decision-making', 'pumpkin' in 'pumpkin-patching', 'meal' in 'meal prepping', and 'is' or "'re" after a subject. Pushes toward 'setting' and 'building'.

L27n1793.name: Split-word pieces, digits 0/1
L27n1793.description: A middle piece of a split word, such as 'spl' in 'splints', 'comm' in 'communities', or a digit '0' or '1' inside a number such as '8.0' or '200-120'. Pushes toward closing parentheses and quotes ('())', '”,').

L27n1313.name: Split-word start pieces
L27n1313.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'sal' in 'salamandas', 'intr' in 'intravascular', 'ro' in 'rots', 'ul' in 'ulcers', 'tyr' in 'tyrannosaurus'. Pushes toward plural nouns for people or lives ('lives', 'hearts', 'minds').

L27n2183.name: Post-system-tag newline; fragments
L27n2183.description: The newline right after '<|im_start|>system' that opens a system prompt, plus mid-word fragments such as 'Emergency' or 't' in 'tail'. Pushes toward code closers ('}]', '");}').

L27n1090.name: Word-initial 'Ar' and 'ar'
L27n1090.description: The 'Ar' or 'ar' that opens a word split into tokens, such as 'Arbuscular', 'Arterial', 'Arthritis', 'arable', and 'ph' or 'ch' starts like 'Phrynosoma'. Pushes toward the letter 'Q'.

L27n2070.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n2070.description: The 'Pl', 'pl', 'pr' or 'sl' that opens words such as 'Plague', 'Plastic', 'plowing', 'prairie', 'slams'. Pushes toward 'actual' and 'actually'.

L27n888.name: Word-start 'sc', 'wh', 'Sp'
L27n888.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'sc' in 'scatters' and 'scrupulous', 'wh' in 'whistling' and 'whizz', 'Sp' in 'Spicy'. Pushes toward LaTeX and code tokens '\(' and '$'.

L27n560.name: Chemical-word later pieces
L27n560.description: The second or later piece of a word split into tokens, mostly chemical roots such as 'to' in 'neurotoxic', 'hydro' in 'hydrogen' and 'hydroxyapatite', and 'EX' in 'T REX'. Pushes toward a bare 'x' or 'X'.

L27n478.name: Word after 'self'
L27n478.description: The word right after 'self' or 'self-' in compounds such as 'self-reliance', 'self-defense', 'self-interest', 'self-preservation', and also after 'over' in 'overpopulation' and 'pre' in 'prepping'. Pushes toward 'interaction', 'response', 'connection'.

L27n666.name: Noun-modifier slot before head
L27n666.description: Fires on the modifier right before the noun it modifies, e.g. 'mobile' in 'mobile phone', 'car' in 'car headlights', 'sea' in 'sea earthquakes', 'metallic' in 'metallic glass', and 'and' or 'their' in noun lists. Pushes toward generic nouns like 'device', 'item', 'node'; steered, it spams 'book'.

L27n1899.name: Split-word first fragment
L27n1899.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into several tokens, e.g. 'Pol' in 'Polycystic', 'Sc' in 'scraping', 'Vil' in 'Vilas', 'se' in 'secede', 'Nar' in 'Narayanganj'. Pushes toward '·', '/*' and 'cdot' tokens; steered, it spams '·' dots.

L27n517.name: Ingredient and list enumeration
L27n517.description: Fires on ingredient-list and enumeration tokens: 'tablespoon', 'minced', 'fresh', 'dried', and the ',' or 'and' joining items in a series (e.g. 'cucumbers,' 'tomatoes,'). Pushes toward chemistry words ('molecular', 'chemical', 'methane'); steered, it spams 'energy'.

L27n612.name: Determiner before noun head
L27n612.description: Fires on the adjective or determiner right before a noun head, e.g. 'different' in 'different heights', 'major' in 'major hurdles', 'these' in 'these requirements', 'negative' in 'negative impacts', 'its' in 'its safe working load'. Pushes toward 'treatment', 'payment', 'production'; steered, it spams 'treatment'.

L27n2506.name: Rare-word fragment pieces
L27n2506.description: Fires on a piece of a rare or transliterated word split into several tokens, e.g. 'ṭ' and 'Yog' in Sanskrit, 'gr' in 'grilling', 'contr' in 'contrarious', 'trib' in 'tribus', 'yll' in 'Phyllis'. Pushes toward '}{', '))){' and 'speaking'; steered, it repeats 'speaking to her'.

L27n2606.name: Word-stem fragment before suffix
L27n2606.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, right before its ending, e.g. 'emb' in 'embarks', 'def' in 'defecate', 'add' in 'addles', 'bb' in 'scribbles', 'rob' in 'robust'. Pushes toward word-ending pieces 'ies', 'ys' and 'y'; steered, it spams 'ies' or 'y' endings.

L27n2385.name: Consonant-cluster word openers
L27n2385.description: Fires on a piece of a word split into tokens, mostly a consonant-led opener: 'pl' in 'plow', 'thr' in 'thrusters', 'bl' in 'blower', '-ca' in 'causing', 'cr' in 'craters', 'Diff' in 'Diffuser'. Pushes toward 'user' and 'users'; steered, it writes 'user' into the story.

L27n2654.name: Short fragment, livestock nouns
L27n2654.description: Fires on a one- or two-letter piece that splits a word or acronym, e.g. 'c' in 'casks', 'k' in 'kettles', 'N' in 'NTDs', '-c' in 'e-cigs', 'unc' in 'uncovers', 'Rec' in 'recycling'. Pushes toward animal and unit nouns ('horse', 'cow', 'sheep', 'Newton'); steered, it spams 'horse'.

L27n427.name: Unfinished name piece
L27n427.description: Fires on a piece of a name or word that is still incomplete, e.g. 'au' in 'Nauvoo', 'Al' in 'Alamein', 'Kap' in 'Kapurthala', 'bas' in 'basmati', 'Beng' in 'Benga', 'Mass' in 'massacre'. Pushes toward 'changes', 'updates', 'shifts' and 'edits'; steered, it spams 'changes'.

L27n1244.name: Word-onset s-clusters
L27n1244.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially s-clusters: 'sc' in 'screech', 'squ' in 'squirts', 'sl', 'Sk', 'suff' in 'suffocate', 'sap' in 'sapodilla'. Pushes toward 'he' and 'she' pronouns; steered, it spams 'he he he'.

L27n1757.name: ML and parameter nouns
L27n1757.description: Fires on technical nouns in ML, statistics and linear-algebra text, e.g. 'parameter' in 'the parameter', 'classification' and 'regression' in models, 'eig' and 'keys' in eigen terms, 'value' in 'simulate a value', and 'into' after motion verbs. Pushes toward 'space' ('parameter space'); steered, it spams 'space'.

L27n1177.name: Stem piece to -ity/-ness
L27n1177.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, just before its ending: 'inhib' in 'inhibitory', 'infl' in 'inflow', 'asympt' in 'asymptomatic', 'radi' in 'radiate', 'follic' in 'follicle'. Pushes toward abstract -ity and -ness nouns ('complexity', 'simplicity', 'uniqueness'); steered, it writes 'simplicity' and 'independence'.

L27n2113.name: Capital acronym fragments
L27n2113.description: Fires on a capitalised piece inside an acronym or name, e.g. 'CI' in 'CIHI', 'BI' in 'BI initiative', 'RI' in 'RRI', 'HI' in 'HIT', 'I' in 'I have'. Pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ches', 'ged', 'cks' and 'ble'; steered, it produces runs of 'sches'.

L27n143.name: Sentence-final punctuation
L27n143.description: Fires on the period, semicolon or colon that closes a sentence or clause, especially right before a line break or list (e.g. '.' after 'over time', ';' before 'and'). Pushes toward closing quote and bracket tokens; steered, it barely changes the answers.

L27n1310.name: Numbers, ordinals, fuel terms
L27n1310.description: Fires on the digit, ordinal or quantity word that gives a measure or grade, e.g. 'one' in 'one degree', '7' in '4.76 inches', '0' in '230 degrees', 'th' in '5th grade', 'first' in 'first grade', plus 'diesel' and 'renewable'. Pushes toward 'standard' and 'std'; steered, it spams 'Standard'.

L27n391.name: Digits inside codes/IDs
L27n391.description: Fires on a digit or superscript number inside a code, ID or measurement, e.g. '4' in '¹⁴C' and '344' in 'Fischer 344', '0' in 'NFPA 70E', '2' in americium-241. Pushes toward number words ('four', 'fourth') and '4'; steered, it spams 'four' or '4444'.

L27n157.name: Answer-start newline, verbs
L27n157.description: Fires on the blank line right after '</think>' that opens a chat answer, and on function words like 'of', 'in' and 'for' inside titles or clauses. Pushes toward bare verbs like 'make', 'decide', 'find' and 'define'; steered, it repeats 'find' or 'make'.

L27n171.name: Name fragments, backslash output
L27n171.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mal' in 'Malawi', 'Moz' in 'Mozambique', 'St' in 'Sticherus', 'out' in 'outperformed', 'Pro' in 'protruding', 'o' in 'oxtail'. Pushes toward backslash escape tokens; steered, it spams a lone backslash or newline escapes.

L27n1513.name: Mid-word piece to small
L27n1513.description: Fires on a middle or later piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'oct' in 'octopus', 'nos' in 'Gymnospermae', 'rap' in 'tetraplegia', 'append' in 'appendicitis', 'anos' in 'deoxyguanosine'. Pushes toward 'small' and 'little'; steered, it writes 'small little little'.

L27n628.name: Pre-number slot to digits
L27n628.description: Fires on the blank space or opening '(' right before a number, e.g. the space before '5%' in '5% carbs', before '6.5 percent', before '50 and 100 hairs', before '10 to 20 minutes', and before a year in '(1943)'. Pushes toward digit tokens like '9', '8' and '7'; steered, it spams '9999'.

L27n2115.name: Proper-name fragment starts
L27n2115.description: The first subword piece of a capitalised surname or first name, right after a person's name or title, e.g. 'Gr' in Grisons, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'Be' in Becciu, 'Gre' in Straume, 'Te' in Teesside. Pushes toward 'decision' tokens.

L27n1250.name: Split-word fragment continuations
L27n1250.description: Short pieces that complete a split word, e.g. '-t' in 'twin-tail' and 'Kaga Sho-taro', 'orth' in 'orthotic', 'reint' in 'reintroduced', 'int' in 'high-intensity', 'ict' in 'Wydawnictwo', plus the short word right after such a piece ('it' in 'toll it takes', 'to' in 'wanted to take'). Pushes toward 'take'.

L27n201.name: Pre-verb slot
L27n201.description: Negative on the token just before a bare verb is expected: 'to' before an infinitive (needed to digest), and verb prefixes before their stem (re in re-occur, under in underpin, super in supercede). Pushes toward base verbs (do, consider, think); steered output spams 'do'.

L27n1445.name: Odd word-start fragment
L27n1445.description: Negative on the first piece of a word split into odd fragments, often hyphen-attached (-al in human-altered, -l in green-lipped, Sp in Spending, exc in excised). Pushes toward 'problem'; steered output spams 'problem'.

L27n1096.name: Mid-clause function word
L27n1096.description: Negative on a function word or comma right after a noun phrase inside a sentence ('and' in 'concept and perform', 'to' in 'come to', 'has' after 'warming', 'with' after 'bee,'), and on list commas. Pushes toward punctuation; weak effect on answers.

L27n740.name: Medical word-start fragment
L27n740.description: The first subword piece of a medical or technical term split into tokens (pur in purists, ple in pleural, par in paraplegia, V in Vitiligo, v in vaccine, tet in tetraplegia). Pushes toward capital letters; steered output spams 'A'.

L27n625.name: b-initial word starts
L27n625.description: The 'b', 'br' or 'Bl' token that opens a word, mostly a split or name-like word: 'b' in 'bumblebee', 'bre' in 'breeder', 'b' in 'basking shark', 'b' in 'bermudagrass', 'Bl' in 'Blasco', 'B' in 'Biodiversity', 'seab' in 'seabirds'. Pushes toward 'bi' and 'bio' tokens.

L27n1957.name: Name/compound first piece
L27n1957.description: The first piece of a multi-token name or compound (Cle in Cleve Cole, Has in Hasmon, Mel in Melons, ipation in Emancipation), and the article 'a' after 'highlight'. Pushes toward 'word'; steered output spams 'word'.

L27n2410.name: Medical word-start fragments
L27n2410.description: The first piece of a split medical or Latinate term: 'ple' in 'pleural' and 'pleura', 'par' in 'paraplegia' and 'parasympathetic', 'pred' in 'prediabetes', 'con' in 'convection' and 'contractile', 'H' in 'Hindus' and 'Harmful', 'per' in 'pernicious'. Pushes toward 'ways' and 'way'.

L27n963.name: Capitalized split-word start
L27n963.description: The first piece of a capitalized word or term split into tokens (G in Ghetto, C in CARRY, iber in Beriberi, ih in hydrogen, B in Blessed, hydro in hydroponic). Pushes toward 'change'.

L27n2375.name: Name-start, digits out
L27n2375.description: The first piece of a capitalized name, code or abbreviation (Ch in Chao Phraya, Ste in Stejskal, AL in AL5, Carm in Carmarthen, A in A1C). Pushes toward digits; steered output turns into number strings.

L27n530.name: Name-piece start, digits out
L27n530.description: Negative on the first piece of a split name or rare word (contr in contrarious, decre in decrees, gl in glia, pur in purports, De in DeLores, Al in Al-Ghazali). Pushes toward digits; steered output shows digit strings.

L27n2497.name: Short word-fragment start
L27n2497.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, often a short fragment (t in tamed and tummy, par in parmesan, sm in smacking, Th in Thracia, Bl in Blaeu). Pushes toward 'great'; steered output spams 'great'.

L27n1444.name: Place/people name fragments
L27n1444.description: Opening fragments of proper nouns, e.g. 'Par' in 'Parthenon', 'Paraguay' and 'Pariah', 'Tar' in 'Tarquin', 'em' in 'empire', 'im' in 'Imams', 'Sc' in 'Scelzo'. Pushes toward 'example'.

L27n2160.name: Long-word middle piece
L27n2160.description: A middle or first piece of a long word or name split into several tokens (lig in Hotamisligil, ome in Domesday, fres in frescoes, Borg in Borglum, f in flossing). Pushes toward 'face'; steered output spams 'face'.

L27n1507.name: Name or code-piece start
L27n1507.description: A piece inside a name, code or abbreviation (Ω after 200, KL in Koenig, -H in self-harming, M in VISION (M), 2 in AL5 2JQ). Pushes toward accented capitals (Å, À, Î); steered text reads normally.

L27n601.name: Split-word piece, 'pi' 'k'
L27n601.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, often a name or technical term (Cr in Crème, b in Middlesbrough, And in Andalus, agr in bermudagrass, ost in somatostatin, Imm in Immune). Pushes toward 'pi', 'k', 'ph'; steered output garbles.

L27n11.name: Copula after topic, negative
L27n11.description: Negative on 'is' or 'was' right after a topic noun at the start of a chat answer (Flamenco is, The Taj Mahal was, Nigeria is, Anubis was). Pushes toward uppercase codes (AK, AB, DP); steered text drops spaces and CamelCases.

L27n669.name: Dot in initialisms, URLs
L27n669.description: The period glued to a capital letter inside an initialism, e.g. '.S' in 'U.S.', '.J' in 'J.J.', '.P' in 'U.P.', '.C' in 'D.C.', plus 'www' in web addresses. Pushes toward a dot before a code method name such as '.SetValue' and '.ToString'.

L27n524.name: Capitalized compound end piece
L27n524.description: The later piece of a capitalized name or compound (NG in MESSENGER, UGHT in DAUGHTER, Object in Object Management, Product in Product Owner, Service in service-oriented). Pushes toward a capital H; steered output spams 'H'.

L27n333.name: Mid-word pieces of names
L27n333.description: Later pieces of a rare name or loanword split into several tokens, e.g. Rad|b|od, Ps|odes, Nakh|on; pushes toward generic subword pieces like 'ai', 'ata', 'num'.

L27n452.name: Second word of compounds
L27n452.description: The second capitalized word of a two-word name or noun compound, e.g. Palm|Oil, European| Centre, White| Turkey; pushes toward phrase openers like 'Known', 'Based', 'Before', and at dose -0.5 it degenerates into repeated 'radorra' tokens.

L27n2674.name: Piece after hyphen
L27n2674.description: The token that starts the second half of a hyphenated compound, e.g. self-|h|arm, meat-|e|aters, cotton-|e|ating, non-|he|ated, plus split starts like 'br' in bruschetta; pushes toward '-ating' and '-ater' word endings.

L27n1879.name: Mid-word capitals in acronyms
L27n1879.description: The middle uppercase piece of an all-caps word or acronym, e.g. I|EL|A, D|ETER|MINE, HOT|BOX, BUS|INESS, GV|WR; pushes toward more uppercase fragments like 'TL', 'NST', 'TY'.

L27n1454.name: Word after comparative/preposition
L27n1454.description: The token right after a comparative, preposition or quantifier, e.g. 'than' in more stable than, 'as' in such as, 'into', 'least', 'high'; the read is diffuse, and pushing it degenerates into repeated 'single'.

L27n1574.name: Diacritics and IPA glyphs
L27n1574.description: Non-ASCII transliteration pieces: IPA symbols (ɪ, ə, ˈ), diacritic letters in Arabic and Sanskrit names (ḥ, ā, ʾ), and accented Latin letters in names (č, ć); pushes toward accented capitals like Č, Ā, Ī.

L27n2301.name: Word-initial cr/con fragments
L27n2301.description: The first piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly short onsets like 'cr', 'com', 'con', 'Ac', 'oc' (cr|umble, con|fluence, oc|currencies); pushes toward the word 'state', spamming 'state state'.

L27n727.name: Opening paren before acronym
L27n727.description: The opening parenthesis just before an acronym or abbreviation, e.g. 'Active Template Library (ATL)', '(LRU)', '(EPA)'; pushes toward fullwidth commas and punctuation, spamming '，，，'.

L27n2961.name: Word-start 'b'/'emb' fragments
L27n2961.description: The first piece of a word split mid-word, often a 'b' or 'dr' onset (Middles|b|rough, Ab|eyance, emb|rittlement, seab|irds); pushes toward 'b'-initial words, spamming 'beth' and 'breathe'.

L27n1628.name: Capital letter in names
L27n1628.description: A capital letter that starts a name part after a hyphen or initial, e.g. 'D' in Miami-|D|ade, 'C' in post-|C|ivil War, 'D' in Sen. |D|ianne; pushes toward 'do' and 'Do', spamming 'Do do do'.

L27n1170.name: Bitcoin and Ethereum tokens
L27n1170.description: Cryptocurrency names, mainly 'Ethereum' and 'Bitcoin' and 'eth' in ETH, plus a few title words like 'A' in A Song of Ice; pushes toward 'white' and 'White', spamming 'White white'.

L27n2599.name: Split-name capital K
L27n2599.description: A capital K, D or E right after a hyphen or name split, e.g. Skutnabb-|K|angas, Boiry-Notre-|D|ame, Kreimer, plus 'heter' in heter|ogeneity; pushes toward 'data' and spams 'lost lost'.

L27n234.name: Word-start sp, Sc pieces
L27n234.description: The first piece of a split verb or adjective, e.g. 'sp' in un|sp|ayed, 'Sc' in |Sc|raping, 'Th' in |Th|inning, 'Hy' in |Hy|giene; pushes toward quotation marks, spamming '"' tokens.

L27n1968.name: Word-start 'cr' fragments
L27n1968.description: The 'cr' piece that starts a split word, e.g. cr|adle, cr|abs, cr|inolines, plus 'tele' in tele|pathically; pushes toward 'learn' and 'learning', spamming 'learning learning'.

L27n2817.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n2817.description: The consonant-cluster start of a split word or name, e.g. 'thr' in |thr|ived, 'Kr' in |Kr|ill oil, 'ste' in |Ste|ak, 'Gre' in |Gre|enshell; pushes toward 'sound', spamming 'Sound sound'.

L27n431.name: Compound prefix micro/electro
L27n431.description: The Greek combining-form prefix at the start of a compound word, e.g. electro-, micro-, gastro-, neuro-, nano-, retro- (electro|fishing, micro|clots, gastro|enterologist); pushes toward suffix pieces like 'al', 'ant', 'ar', 'alg'.

L27n1092.name: Split capitalized name tails
L27n1092.description: The second piece of a capitalized name or long word, after a capital first piece, e.g. Car|ica, Min|ar, Ch|akma, Con|ception, Fem|ales, Bour|ges; pushes toward 'calculation', 'analysis', 'validation'.

L27n893.name: Digit in COVID-19
L27n893.description: A digit inside a split number or year, e.g. the '1' in COVID-|1|9, and the 7, 8 and 0 in 19|7|9, 1|8|97, 20|0|9; pushes toward 'nine' and spams 'nine nine'.

L27n2463.name: Middle pieces of words
L27n2463.description: The middle or second piece of a word split into three or more tokens, e.g. 'oo' in sm|oo|ching, 'clo' in clo|aking, 'oph' in Hymen|oph|yllaceae, 'ago' in M|ago|thy; pushes toward 'this', 'these', 'those'.

L27n967.name: Proper-name first pieces
L27n967.description: The first token of a capitalized name split into pieces, e.g. 'Ste' in Stefan, 'Wol' in Wolpertinger, 'Mer' in Merthyr, 'Dal' in Dalmau; pushes toward '{' braces, spamming '{ { {'.

L27n454.name: Word fragments, turn breaks
L27n454.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces (e.g. 'Pr' in 'Di|Pr|ima') and on the newline gap right after a user turn ends and the assistant's '<think>' block opens; pushing it negative makes replies terse, with short declarative sentences.
